checks.source_as_cited: Kelly 1998 PhD thesis (York); IEEE Std 1012; Armstrong 2003 PhD thesis (KTH)
checks.note: Evidence: my recall of the standard bibliographic records and well-known descriptions. I did not fetch any source. Kelly's thesis is the standard GSN source, with goal, strategy, solution, context, assumption and undeveloped-goal nodes. Armstrong's thesis covers supervision trees and 'let it crash'. IEEE 1012 covers IV&V. The sources support each part. The mapping itself (field reviews as sub-claims, certification as the independent assessor, dismissals as the hazard log, restart intensity 1) is the design's own analogy, not something the sources state. IEEE 1012 has since been revised, so give the edition (the 2016 revision is current in my recall).

checks.source_as_cited: Mills 1972, On the Statistical Validation of Computer Programs, IBM FSD FSC-72-6015
checks.note: Evidence: recalled bibliographic record (the report is reprinted in Mills' 1983 book). Mills proposed seeding faults and estimating the remaining real faults from the ratio of seeded to real faults found. The estimate is only unbiased under the stated assumption of equal detectability. Real faults are usually harder to find than seeded ones, so the 'unbiased' wording should carry that condition. The detector-blindness assumption is right.
checks.correction: Say 'unbiased only if seeded and real faults are equally likely to be found'.

checks.source_as_cited: DeMillo, Lipton, Sayward 1978, Hints on Test Data Selection, IEEE Computer 11(4)
checks.note: Evidence: recalled bibliographic record (IEEE Computer 11(4), 34-41). It introduced the mutation idea, the competent-programmer hypothesis and the coupling effect. Both are hypotheses, not theorems, and the claimed assumptions say so.

checks.source_as_cited: Arlat et al. 1990, Fault Injection for Dependability Validation, IEEE TSE 16(2)
checks.note: Evidence: recalled bibliographic record (IEEE TSE 16(2), 166-182). It estimates coverage with statistical confidence from injection experiments. Representativeness of the injected fault model is the stated limit.

checks.source_as_cited: Avizienis 1985, The N-Version Approach to Fault-Tolerant Software, IEEE TSE SE-11(12)
checks.note: Evidence: recalled bibliographic record (pp. 1491-1501). Voting masks floor((N-1)/2) failed versions when failures are independent, and N>=3 is needed for voting. The paper argues for independent design diversity but does not guarantee independence. The claim is right only conditional on that assumption, which the claim itself states.

checks.source_as_cited: Eckhardt & Lee 1985, IEEE TSE SE-11(12)
checks.note: Evidence: recalled bibliographic record (pp. 1511-1517) and the standard textbook description. The model gives P(both fail)=E[theta^2] >= (E[theta])^2 for independently developed versions with varying input difficulty. The population assumption is correct.

checks.source_as_cited: Knight & Leveson 1986, IEEE TSE SE-12(1)
checks.note: Evidence: recalled bibliographic record (pp. 96-109). 27 versions were written by students at two universities. The independence hypothesis was rejected at a high confidence level. Coincident faults were attributed partly to specification misreadings and partly to common difficulties in the problem and algorithm. 'Traced back to the shared specification' is therefore too narrow.
checks.correction: Say 'coincident faults, many from shared misunderstanding of the problem and specification'.

checks.source_as_cited: Littlewood & Miller 1989, IEEE TSE 15(12)
checks.note: Evidence: recalled bibliographic record (pp. 1596-1614). The paper shows that forced diversity can give coincident-failure probability below the independence value. The claimed assumption, that diversity is designed along the right dimension, is right.

checks.source_as_cited: Scott, Gault, McAllister 1987, Fault-Tolerant Software Reliability Modeling, IEEE TSE SE-13(5)
checks.note: Evidence: recalled bibliographic record (pp. 582-592). The paper models recovery blocks, N-version programming and the consensus recovery block, which votes first and falls back to an acceptance test. The claimed guarantee matches. Independence of the acceptance test is a modelling assumption there, and I could not confirm its exact wording.

checks.source_as_cited: Saltzer, Reed, Clark 1984, End-to-End Arguments in System Design, ACM TOCS 2(4)
checks.note: Evidence: recalled bibliographic record (pp. 277-288). The paper argues that the function can be completely and correctly implemented only with the endpoints' knowledge, and that lower-level checks are performance enhancements. The claim matches.

checks.source_as_cited: Fagan 1976, IBM Systems Journal 15(3)
checks.note: Evidence: recalled bibliographic record (pp. 182-211). The paper describes inspection stages, entry and exit criteria, defect recording and rework with follow-up. It also gives data per phase. Preparation and a controlled inspection rate are part of the method.

checks.source_as_cited: Boehm 1981, Software Engineering Economics, Prentice-Hall
checks.note: Evidence: recalled bibliographic record. The book gives the widely cited cost-to-fix-rises-by-phase curve. That curve has been challenged empirically, so it is an economic argument, not a guarantee. The claim says 'economic argument', which is fair.

checks.source_as_cited: Leveson 2011, Engineering a Safer World, MIT Press
checks.note: Evidence: recalled bibliographic record. STPA checks each control action against four unsafe-control-action types: not provided, provided unsafely, wrong timing or order, and stopped too soon or applied too long. Coverage is relative to the control-structure model, as claimed.

checks.source_as_cited: MIL-STD-1629A (1980), FMECA procedures
checks.note: Evidence: recalled bibliographic record (dated 24 Nov 1980). The standard was cancelled in 1998 with no replacement, so cite it as historical. The single-failure and completeness assumptions are standard FMEA limits.

checks.source_as_cited: Vesely et al. 1981, Fault Tree Handbook, NUREG-0492
checks.note: Evidence: recalled bibliographic record. The handbook covers minimal cut sets for a defined top event, and the result depends on a correct top event and decomposition.

checks.source_as_cited: Avizienis, Laprie, Randell, Landwehr 2004, IEEE TDSC 1(1)
checks.note: Evidence: recalled bibliographic record (pp. 11-33). The taxonomy has failure domain (content, early or late timing, halt, erratic), detectability (signalled or unsignalled) and consistency (consistent or inconsistent). The claim matches.

checks.source_as_cited: Eick et al. 1992, Estimating Software Fault Content Before Coding, Proc. ICSE 14
checks.note: Evidence: recalled bibliographic record (pp. 59-65). The paper applies capture-recapture to inspection data. It assumes inspectors find defects independently and with similar probabilities, and the paper itself reports the estimate is biased when that fails. The claim matches.

checks.source_as_cited: IEC 61508-7:2010 Annex A
checks.note: Evidence: recalled description of the standard. Annex A lists watchdog, separate-time-base and program-sequence-monitoring measures (temporal and logical). Independence of the watchdog is a stated condition. I could not check the exact clause numbers.

checks.source_as_cited: AUTOSAR Classic Platform, Specification of Watchdog Manager
checks.note: Evidence: recalled description of the spec. The Watchdog Manager defines alive supervision, deadline supervision and logical supervision, based on checkpoints instrumented in the supervised entities. No version is cited, so one should be added.

checks.source_as_cited: Randell 1975, System Structure for Software Fault Tolerance, IEEE TSE SE-1(2)
checks.note: Evidence: recalled bibliographic record (pp. 220-232). Recovery points, backward recovery and the domino effect are all in the paper. The domino effect is avoided by structuring interacting processes into conversations with coordinated recovery lines, not merely when processes exchange no messages between their recovery points. The claim's condition is a special case.
checks.correction: Say 'avoided by coordinating recovery points across interacting processes (conversations, recovery lines), or when processes do not interact'.

checks.source_as_cited: Armstrong 2003, KTH thesis (supervision trees, restart intensity)
checks.note: Evidence: recalled description of the thesis and of Erlang/OTP supervisor documentation. The thesis covers supervision trees and 'let it crash'. The MaxR-within-MaxT bound with escalation is how the OTP supervisor behaves, and I am less sure the thesis states it in those terms. The 'restarts are cheap, fault transient' assumption is a design rationale, not a proved guarantee.

checks.source_as_cited: Gray 1985, Why Do Computers Stop and What Can Be Done About It?, Tandem TR 85.7
checks.note: Evidence: recalled bibliographic record (June 1985). The report argues that most production software faults are soft or transient, so a restart or process-pair takeover works, and it contrasts these with deterministic faults. The Bohrbug and Heisenbug wording is commonly credited to Gray; I did not verify it is in this report.

checks.source_as_cited: Randell 1975, recovery blocks
checks.note: Evidence: recalled bibliographic record. The recovery block is a primary and alternates behind an acceptance test, with state restored before each alternate runs. The claimed guarantee and its assumptions match.

checks.source_as_cited: Saltzer, Reed, Clark 1984
checks.note: Evidence: recalled bibliographic record. The paper supports the idea that correctness is checkable only at the endpoint. 'State never recorded cannot be checked' is a sensible corollary, but the paper does not say it.

checks.source_as_cited: Dodge & Romig 1929, A Method of Sampling Inspection, Bell System Technical Journal 8
checks.note: Evidence: recalled bibliographic record (BSTJ 8(4), 613-631). The paper gives lot-tolerance (LTPD) and average-outgoing-quality-limit (AOQL) plans with 100 % inspection of rejected lots. The operating characteristic curve and the AOQL bound hold under random sampling, homogeneous lots and perfect inspection.

checks.source_as_cited: ISO 2859-1, Sampling procedures for inspection by attributes
checks.note: Evidence: recalled description of the standard. The full title is 'Sampling procedures for inspection by attributes, Part 1: Sampling schemes indexed by acceptance quality limit (AQL) for lot-by-lot inspection'. Sample-size and acceptance-number tables are right. The cited title omits the part number and subtitle, and no edition year is given.
checks.correction: Cite as ISO 2859-1 (Part 1), with the AQL lot-by-lot subtitle and an edition year (1999 in my recall; a revision may exist).

checks.source_as_cited: Lions et al. 1996, ARIANE 5 Flight 501 Failure: Report by the Inquiry Board
checks.note: Evidence: recalled description of the report. The failure came from Ariane 4 alignment software reused under Ariane 5 flight conditions whose assumptions (horizontal bias range) did not hold. The report recommends reviewing and justifying reuse assumptions. The claim fits.

checks.source_as_cited: Kelly 1998 thesis (context and assumption nodes)
checks.note: Evidence: recalled description of GSN. Context and assumption nodes attach scope and assumptions to goals and strategies. The 'shared vocabulary' condition is the design's own addition and not from the thesis.

checks.source_as_cited: IEEE Std 1012 (independent V&V)
checks.note: Evidence: recalled description of the standard. It defines IV&V independence as technical, managerial and financial. The claimed guarantee follows from technical independence. No edition is cited.

checks.source_as_cited: Mills 1972, error seeding applied to a reviewer
checks.note: Evidence: recalled bibliographic record. Mills' method targets estimating program faults. Using it to measure a reviewer's detection rate is a reasonable extension of the same logic, with the stated assumptions, but it is not what the report itself does.

checks.source_as_cited: Basili et al. 1996, The Empirical Investigation of Perspective-Based Reading, Empirical Software Engineering 1(2)
checks.note: Evidence: recalled bibliographic record (pp. 133-164; authors as cited). The study found perspective-based reading detected more defects than ad hoc reading in the settings tested. Evidence that different perspectives find different defects is weaker and mixed across the replications.

checks.source_as_cited: MIL-STD-882E (2012), System Safety
checks.note: Evidence: recalled description of the standard (dated May 2012). It requires a hazard tracking system, with closure supported by verification evidence and acceptance by the designated risk-acceptance authority. The claim matches.

result.overall: I did not open any source. Every check rests on my recall of bibliographic records and standard textbook descriptions, and I say so in each note. All 37 citations point to real works, and authors, years and venues match. Two entries have a bibliographic gap (ISO 2859-1 title and edition, MIL-STD-1629A cancelled in 1998). Several claims are stated too strongly. Mills' estimate is unbiased only under the equal-detectability assumption. Randell's domino-effect condition is narrower than the full recovery-line treatment. Knight and Leveson traced coincident faults to more than the specification. Perspective-based reading evidence for different perspectives finding different defects is mixed. The restart-intensity wording in the Armstrong item is OTP behaviour, and I am unsure the thesis states it that way. The supervision-tree and GSN mapping in D4-whole is the design's own analogy. Nothing was marked could_not_check, but a pass that fetched the sources would be firmer on page numbers, clause numbers and exact wording.
